portfolioProjects.title: Campus Insight II — Skans Institute
portfolioProjects.description: Google Play Store published educational application featuring role-based access, video streaming, and real-time push notifications.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built a full-featured educational application enabling digital learning through role-based access, video streaming, and real-time push notifications for Skans Institute.
portfolioProjects.problem: Students and faculty needed a seamless digital learning portal with secure access control, low-latency video streaming, and immediate push announcements for academic updates.
portfolioProjects.solution: Spearheaded the development of Campus Insight II using native Kotlin and MVVM Architecture. Integrated Retrofit for REST APIs, Firebase for Auth and Realtime Database, and OneSignal for instant notification dispatch.
portfolioProjects.architecture: Clean MVVM Architecture, Repository pattern, Retrofit network abstraction layer, OneSignal push listener services.

portfolioProjects.title: Rabbet (Paylink) — FinTech App
portfolioProjects.description: Secure payment application with OTP-based authentication and payment workflows for the Egyptian market.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built core features of a secure payment application with OTP-based authentication and seamless transaction workflows for the Egyptian market.
portfolioProjects.problem: Financial users in Egypt required a reliable mobile payment mechanism with rapid OTP authentication, zero transaction dropouts, and encrypted payload delivery.
portfolioProjects.solution: Engineered native Android payment workflows in Kotlin with Retrofit REST APIs and Firebase verification. Optimized payload encryption and network state management to guarantee financial transaction integrity.
portfolioProjects.architecture: MVVM Architecture, Security Encryption Layer, Retrofit Interceptors, Firebase Authentication.

portfolioProjects.title: ParrotPal — AI Calorie Tracking App
portfolioProjects.description: AI-powered health application for intelligent calorie tracking with QR barcode scanning and nutritional APIs.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built an AI-powered health application for calorie tracking with QR code scanning and nutritional API integration.
portfolioProjects.problem: Users needed an easy way to track dietary calories and scan meal barcodes without manually typing complex nutritional details.
portfolioProjects.solution: Integrated Zxing barcode scanner with MVVM Architecture and Navigation Component in Kotlin. Connected to nutritional REST APIs for real-time meal analysis and calorie tracking.
portfolioProjects.architecture: MVVM Architecture, Navigation Component, Zxing Barcode SDK, Retrofit network layer.

portfolioProjects.title: Forsa — Multivendor E-commerce App
portfolioProjects.description: Full-featured e-commerce application for buyers and vendors with REST API integration and dynamic product management.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built a full-featured e-commerce application for buyers and vendors with REST API integration and dynamic product management.
portfolioProjects.problem: Multivendor platforms require smooth image rendering, fast product filter catalogs, vendor stores, and robust session persistence.
portfolioProjects.solution: Developed in Kotlin/Java with Retrofit, dynamic RecyclerView adapters, Navigation Component, and local SharedPreferences caching.
portfolioProjects.architecture: MVVM with Java/Kotlin interop, Dynamic Adapter pattern, Retrofit HTTP client.

portfolioProjects.title: Baby SOS — Childcare App
portfolioProjects.description: Confidential client childcare application built from scratch using Flutter, GetX, MVVM, and Clean Architecture.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built a childcare application from scratch using GetX, MVVM, and Clean Architecture with robust API integration and error handling.
portfolioProjects.problem: Parents needed a secure, highly responsive mobile app for emergency alerts, childcare scheduling, and real-time status updates.
portfolioProjects.solution: Architected a Flutter solution using GetX state management and Clean Architecture. Implemented robust REST API handlers with graceful offline fallbacks.
portfolioProjects.architecture: Flutter Clean Architecture, GetX Reactive Controllers, Repositories, REST API Services.

portfolioProjects.title: JKL Therapy — Medical App
portfolioProjects.description: Medical therapy application featuring secure authentication, dashboard implementation, and API integration using Provider.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built a medical therapy application featuring secure authentication, dashboard implementation, and API integration using Provider.
portfolioProjects.problem: Therapy patients needed a clean, therapeutic UI dashboard to track session schedules, physician notes, and therapy progress.
portfolioProjects.solution: Engineered in Flutter with Provider state management. Integrated secure Auth tokens and responsive patient metrics cards.
portfolioProjects.architecture: Flutter Provider Pattern, Modular Screen Components, Secure Token Storage.

portfolioProjects.title: FoxtINN — Hotel Operations Platform
portfolioProjects.description: End-to-end full-stack hotel operations platform: Next.js (React) web app, Node.js backend, and Flutter mobile app with geofencing & tasks.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Built a full-stack hotel operations platform end-to-end — Next.js (React) web app, Node.js backend, and Flutter mobile app — covering scheduling, geofenced time clock, tasks, housekeeping, maintenance, and guest requests.
portfolioProjects.problem: Hotels struggled with fragmented staff schedules, manual timekeeping, delayed housekeeping tasks, and untracked guest requests.
portfolioProjects.solution: Built an integrated platform featuring Next.js web dashboard for managers, Node.js backend with Socket.io for live synchronization, and a Flutter mobile app with GPS geofenced time clock for staff.
portfolioProjects.architecture: Full-Stack Microservices & Monorepo: Next.js Frontend, Node/Express Backend, Flutter Mobile App, Socket.io Realtime Layer.

portfolioProjects.title: Flutter Web E-commerce Application
portfolioProjects.description: Responsive web-based e-commerce application in Flutter Web optimizing multi-device layouts and performance.
portfolioProjects.longDescription: Enhanced a responsive web-based e-commerce application by resolving UI issues and optimizing layouts across devices.
portfolioProjects.problem: Web layout inconsistencies across desktop monitors, tablets, and mobile browsers hampered user conversions.
portfolioProjects.solution: Refactored Flutter Web layout engine with responsive breakpoints, state optimization using Provider, and image caching.
portfolioProjects.architecture: Flutter Web Responsive Architecture, Provider pattern, LayoutBuilder breakpoint system.
